# Let's query NCBI gene or check protein lengths across common organisms (human, mouse)
import urllib.request
import json

def get_ncbi_gene(gene_symbol):
    url = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esearch.fcgi?db=gene&term={gene_symbol}[Gene+Name]+AND+Homo+sapiens[Organism]&retmode=json"
    with urllib.request.urlopen(url) as resp:
        data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
    id_list = data['esearchresult']['idlist']
    if not id_list:
        return None
    gene_id = id_list[0]
    
    url_sum = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esummary.fcgi?db=gene&id={gene_id}&retmode=json"
    with urllib.request.urlopen(url_sum) as resp:
        sum_data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
    return sum_data['result'][gene_id]

def get_uniprot_info_mouse(gene_name):
    url = f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search?query=gene_exact:{gene_name}+AND+organism_id:10090+AND+reviewed:true&format=json"
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as response:
        data = json.loads(response.read().decode())
    results = []
    for entry in data.get('results', []):
        results.append((entry['primaryAccession'], entry['sequence']['length']))
    return results

def get_all_isoforms(acc):
    url = f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.json"
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as response:
        data = json.loads(response.read().decode())
    return data['sequence']['length'], [c for c in data.get('comments', []) if c.get('commentType') == 'ALTERNATIVE PRODUCTS']

# Let's check NCBI RefSeq for human CNOT3 and RTF2 canonical / longest proteins:
import urllib.request
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

def get_refseq_proteins(gene_id):
    url = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esummary.fcgi?db=gene&id={gene_id}&retmode=json"
    # Actually let's query nuccore/protein via efetch or elink
    url_link = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/elink.fcgi?dbfrom=gene&db=protein&id={gene_id}&linkname=gene_protein_refseq&retmode=json"
    with urllib.request.urlopen(url_link) as resp:
        data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
    linkset = data['linksets'][0]
    p_ids = [ls['id'] for ls in linkset.get('linksetdbs', [{}])[0].get('links', [])]
    
    url_psum = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esummary.fcgi?db=protein&id={','.join(p_ids[:10])}&retmode=json"
    with urllib.request.urlopen(url_psum) as resp:
        p_data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
    results = []
    for pid in p_ids[:10]:
        item = p_data['result'][pid]
        results.append((item.get('caption'), item.get('slen'), item.get('title')))
    return results

print("CNOT3 RefSeq proteins (Gene ID 4849):", get_refseq_proteins("4849"))
